description: Use this when someone wants a doctor for medical weight loss or an AMITA practice in Germany. Returns the nearest AMITA practices with address, doctor, distance and next free time; locationFound is false when no place was recognised. Not for medical advice, prescriptions or emergencies.

location.description: Search area the person named: city, district or German postcode, e.g. "Berlin Moabit" or "10551". Without it the search uses the approximate location the client shares.
